title: 第13章 背锅侠第14章 老家伙们被打脸
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
阎川道：“怕什么，咱们花那么多钱买他的剑符，结果都是一级的垃圾符，好几名师弟差点死在妖兽之口，还不让我们说吗？”
“实在不行就找执法殿。”
那师弟道：“话虽如此，但我听说七师叔可是内门出了名的护犊子，到时候秦峰师兄最多受点小惩罚，要不还是算了！”
其他一些弟子也都打了退堂鼓，他们这些外门弟子要经过大比才能拜师进入内门，他们平时见到内门弟子，都像孙子一样。
阎川道：“你们不去拉倒，反正我去，那灵石是我做一年任务才攒下的，凭什么就这样被骗？”
远处，商世杰跟袁武看着这里发生的一切。
之前他已经将假符的事情全都推到秦峰身上了。
商世杰道：“师兄，你说他能拿出那么多四级符咒，还免费送给他们吗？”
袁武一笑道：“那家伙又贪酒又贪财，我估计钱早就让他买酒了。”
“他可是在众长老面前答应过了，如果他拿不出来，我就告诉师父。”
众人来到秦峰小院前，就没有一个人敢上前敲门的。
秦峰感知到外边来人，便走了出来，见到门口足有八十多人。
有些人应该是过来看热闹的。
他们见到秦峰出来以后，瞬间都躲到了阎川身后，将他挡在了前面。
阎川此刻心也慌的一批，最终还是鼓足勇气，呲牙笑道：“秦峰师兄，昨晚睡得好吗？”
顿时引来众人一阵的白眼和鄙视，家伙在山下的时候那么勇，现在这么怂，勇气呢？
简直太丢人了，有些人离他远了一些，羞与这种人为伍。
秦峰淡淡一笑道：“你不用拐弯抹角，我知道你们来的目的。”
“但你们之前买的四级符咒不是我画的。”
众人都一脸懵圈，不是秦峰师兄画的？

众人顿时议论纷纷，在探讨秦峰说话的真实性。
下一刻，秦峰拿出一张半月斩符甩向旁边的一块五十丈高的大石，大石顿时被炸成了一片飞灰。
这一击足以抵得上金丹期的一击，众人都惊得目瞪口呆。
秦峰道：“这才是我刻画剑符的威力。
你们之前是被商世杰骗了。”
众人一听这话，顿时义愤填膺，原来是被那个胖子给骗了，果然是奸商！
秦峰又道：“大家辛苦赚点灵石也不容易，我这里有四十张剑符，送给大家，如果你们用好了，下次来我这里买，假一赔十。”
众人简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，秦峰师兄居然要送给他们四级剑符？
阎川激动的热泪盈眶道：“秦峰师兄大义！”
“秦峰师兄大义！”
声音一浪高过一浪，后面院子正在睡觉的穆无双暴躁的坐起身来，她最烦的就是别人打扰她睡懒觉。
“这个臭小子在搞什么鬼？打扰老娘睡美容觉，看我不打死你！”
当神识扫过秦峰这里，发现情况以后，穆无双愕然道：“臭小子，还挺会收买人心的！”
看来杀剑锋下一届能多收一些弟子了。
想到这里，她心情好了不少。”
content_en:
Yan Chuan said: "What are you afraid of? We spent so much money to buy his sword talismans, but they turned out to be first-level rubbish talismans. Several junior fellow apprentices almost died in the mouths of monsters. Why don't you let us talk about it?"
"If it doesn't work, go to the Law Enforcement Hall."
The junior brother said: "Having said that, I heard that the seventh uncle is a famous calf protector in the inner sect. When the time comes, senior brother Qin Feng will at most receive a small punishment, or else forget it!"
Some other disciples also gave up. They, the outer sect disciples, had to go through a competition before they could become disciples and enter the inner sect. When they saw the inner sect disciples, they looked like grandsons.
Yan Chuan said: "If you don't go and pull me down, I'll go anyway. I saved that spiritual stone after doing a year of work. Why should I be deceived like this?"
In the distance, Shang Shijie and Yuan Wu watched everything happening here.
He had already blamed Qin Feng for the fake talisman before.
Shang Shijie said: "Brother, do you think he can produce so many level-4 spells and give them to them for free?"
Yuan Wu smiled and said: "That guy is greedy for wine and money. I guess the money has already given him money to buy wine."
"He promised in front of all the elders. If he can't come up with it, I will tell the master."
When everyone came to Qin Feng's courtyard, no one dared to knock on the door.
Qin Feng sensed someone coming outside, so he walked out and saw more than eighty people at the door.
Some people should have come to watch the fun.
When they saw Qin Feng coming out, they immediately hid behind Yan Chuan and blocked him in front.
Yan Chuan was panicking at this moment, but finally he mustered up the courage, bared his teeth and said with a smile: "Senior Brother Qin Feng, did you sleep well last night?"
Suddenly everyone rolled their eyes and looked down upon him. He was so brave when he was at the bottom of the mountain, but now he is so timid. Where is his courage?
It was so embarrassing that some people stayed away from him, ashamed to be in the company of such a person.
Qin Feng smiled lightly and said, "You don't have to beat around the bush, I know the purpose of your coming."
"But the level 4 spell you bought before was not drawn by me."
Everyone was confused. Wasn't it painted by Senior Brother Qin Feng?
Everyone immediately started talking, discussing the authenticity of Qin Feng's words.
The next moment, Qin Feng took out a Half-Moon Cutting Talisman and threw it at a fifty-foot-tall boulder next to him. The boulder was immediately blown into ashes.
This blow was enough to be worth a strike at the Golden Core Stage, and everyone was stunned with shock.
Qin Feng said: "This is the power of my sword talisman.
You were deceived by Shang Shijie before. "
When everyone heard this, they were immediately filled with indignation. It turned out that they had been deceived by the fat man, and he was indeed a profiteer!
Qin Feng added: "It's not easy for everyone to earn some spiritual stones through hard work. I have forty sword talismans here for everyone. If you use them well, come to me to buy them next time, and I will compensate you ten for each fake one."
Everyone couldn't believe their ears. Senior Brother Qin Feng actually wanted to give them a fourth-level sword talisman?
Yan Chuan's eyes filled with excitement and he said: "Senior Brother Qin Feng is righteous!"
"Senior Brother Qin Feng is righteous!"
The voice got louder and louder. Mu Wushuang, who was sleeping in the yard behind, sat up angrily. What bothered her most was that others disturbed her sleep.
"What the hell is this brat doing? I'll beat you to death if you disturb my beauty sleep!"
When his consciousness scanned Qin Feng's place and discovered the situation, Mu Wushuang said in shock: "You brat, you are quite good at buying people's hearts!"
It seems that Sha Jianfeng will be able to recruit more disciples next time.
Thinking of this, she felt much better. "
